description: Saves a draft request to a real, manually approved human developer: a question, a code review, a consultation or hands-on help with a software problem. It takes a short summary in plain words, which must not contain passwords, API keys, tokens or other secrets. Only a draft is saved: nothing reaches a developer until it is sent, and nothing is charged. It returns the exact saved text and a task_id.

availability.description: When the person is free for a call, for example 'weekdays after 5pm CET'. Optional.

summary.description: What the person needs, in plain words: what is wrong or what they want help with, what they were doing, and what has already been tried. No secrets.

tool.description: The AI tool the app was built with, if known.

name: ask_human_developer
title: Ask a human developer
